question:
There is a definite relationship between figures A and B. Establish a similar relationship between figures C and D by selecting a suitable figure from the answer set that would replace the question mark (?) in figure D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/528dada406379413e10df036aaad12d5393f52fc2643acafa15720c993857632.png]
solution:
The logic is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0c7dd169143d16a3c64723259eeb2e5588011297e31748d5d753da3b45dacf7.png] → First two elements 'TC' rotates 180 degree clockwise. Thirst element '()' shifts to 4th position in figure B and is replaced by a solid black color filled star. 4th element 'S' shifts to 3rd position in figure B and is rotated 90 degree clockwise.

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/131e28b33edfd70cc8439369f766ba96930f7aa9bc6ce82800315a592a381fcc.png] → First two elements rotates 180 degree clockwise. Thirst element rectangle shifts to 4th position in figure B and is replaced by a solid black color filled circle. 4th element '+' shifts to 3rd position in figure B and is rotated 90 degree clockwise.

Hence, the correct option is “Option 2”.
